controls.startupPalette: Each outer PetalAppearance references a shared Peacock Startup Tone asset. Edit Colors on that asset to tune the opening fill, gold, amber, tertiary inlay and glow strengths.
controls.mainPatternIntensity: Gold border, rings and main feather ribs.
controls.accentPatternIntensity: Amber details and the tertiary-colored iris, droplets and tip.
controls.emissionScale: Existing shared/per-petal glow control multiplies both regions.
controls.takeover: First normal palette request consumes startup for the addressed petals, even when the requested enum already equals Base. TransitionTo uses the existing radial palette wave; SetState changes immediately. Disable/enable preserves consumption; a newly instantiated flower receives opening colors.
controls.regularPalette: Existing Glow Trial Outer Tone 1 and 2 references retained unchanged. Tertiary alpha zero falls back to that regular state's Accent color, so initial blue/pink inlays are overwritten. Set an opaque Tertiary color in a regular state to author it independently.
controls.artwork: Peacock ornament remains the outer base artwork while its colors change. Existing symbol replacement/reveal also erases the tertiary artwork and glow correctly.

assets.generation: Built-in image_gen, exact prompt in generation-prompt.txt
assets.packing: Source unchanged; technical mask extraction with exact UV-contour border. Artwork UV mapping preserves circular proportions in mesh dimensions.
